ratings.note: Manual mode is used only for reservoir work; the message misleads but the critical goal (stop dosing) is met.
Same problem as the pump-start message; confusion, not a block.
Jargon slows new volunteers and visitors; learned over time.
Few forced-colours users, but the critical control has no visible affordance or state for them; status text partly compensates.
Blocks status for screen-reader users; departed from 4 because screen-reader use on the bay tablet is rare and the lead reviews each shift.
Red fault with no reason or next step; untrained volunteers cannot act on it.
Only a clock time; stale readings can be trusted as current when the feed drops.
Safety setting silently reverts on reload; pumps may dose into a drained tank on the critical journey.
Amber and Warm without target or action; mild delay, the value itself is shown.
Colour-blind growers cannot find the faulty sensor; departed from 4 as it hits a core, not critical, task and other cards partly help.
Duplicate landmark adds noise for screen-reader navigation only.
Unlabelled dots with no legend; departed from 4 since red/amber/green is broadly understood by sighted non-colour-blind users.
No ranges; novices cannot judge drift towards limits but status words exist.
Name mismatch across sections; learnable once explained.
Nav label differs from heading; section is first on the page, small cost.
History values not readable visually; current value is on the card.
Warm vs In range ambiguous for the one borderline reading.
Pump history runs on from status; times usually resolve the doubt.
Conflicting green card and red sensor for the same tank; grower cannot tell if action is needed.
Colour-only, unnamed status dots; departed from 4 for consistency with B-001/B-002 (core, not critical, task).
No stale/offline state; volunteers may act on old readings when the feed drops.
Chart shows shape only; current value available on the card.
